request.text: Please look at the login change first.

note: to is a hire's id, nickname or name. id is yours: the same id twice delivers once. Without one, the app makes one and answers it.
text-the-hire-gets:
— from the GM (Smolcorp), message gm-2026-11-01-001

Please look at the login change first.

from-a-hire.how: the hire sends its own key, from its environment SMOLCORP_HIRE_KEY, in the header x-smolcorp-hire-key (never the GM token). The app finds the hire from the key; nothing in the body can name another sender.

answer.note: Kept for the GM to read; not typed into its session.

from-a-hire.to-another-hire: 403 unless the pair was allowed with POST /setup/gm/contacts; an unknown name gets the same 403
from-a-hire.limit: mailPerHour counts each hire's messages on their own

refusals.why: the id uses letters, digits, - _ and . only, 64 at most
mail is never put into the GM's own session; the GM reads smolcorp gm inbox
the name is used twice, or the hire is fired or failed
over mailPerHour for this sender, naming the limit

waiting: a window at a question, a menu, a draft or at work is never written into: the message stays queued and is looked at again on every pump, which is not a try, until the hire is free or mailWaitHours (default 24) have passed since it was sent, and then it is left; real trouble (tmux, a dead session) is tried every 30 seconds and counts, and the message is left after 6 tries; a left message is never sent again by itself
